type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be four
            digits and, when the city belongs to a known region (Sydney->NSW,
            Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), fall within that region's postcode
            range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no
            known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as
            given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag supplied on create. An owner may join an existing
            household (another owner with the same last name and postcode); the
            joining owner's membershipLevel is capped at one above the household's
            current maximum. When true, the owner is declared a genuine household
            member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate; when absent or
            false the owner is still registered but is flagged as a possible
            duplicate of the existing household member.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formed as the title followed by a single
                space and the last name (for example 'DR who'), or just the last
                name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last
                name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes. For
                example '+61412345678' is returned as '+61 412 345 678'. The raw
                'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member identifier, formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'. REGION is the region code derived from
                the owner's postcode (UNKNOWN when it maps to no known region); FY
                is the two-digit fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate (the fiscal year starts on 1 July and is
                identified by the calendar year in which it ends); HASH8 is the
                first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the
                normalized telephone concatenated with the last name; and CHK is a
                single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. On collision with an existing owner's
                memberId a '-<n>' suffix (n starting at 2) is appended.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate,
                formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal
                year. The fiscal year runs from 1 July to 30 June and is
                identified by the calendar year in which it ends, so a
                registration on or after 1 July belongs to the fiscal year ending
                the following calendar year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners that belong to the same
                household. Derived deterministically as the first 12 hex
                characters of the SHA-256 digest of the owner's normalized last
                name, a '|' separator and the postcode, so every owner sharing a
                last name and postcode resolves to the same value automatically.
                Null when the owner was created without a postcode.
              type: string
              example: '1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Zero when the owner's name was
                unique on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned on create. Starts at 0,
                gains 2 when an email is present, gains 1 when the owner's name
                was unique on create (namesakeCount is 0), gains 2 for a
                household of three or more members, and gains 3 for tenure over
                one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned on create.
                Derived from membershipPoints: level 1 (0-1 points), level 2
                (2-3 points), level 3 (4-5 points), level 4 (6 or more points).
                A new owner's level is then capped so it never exceeds one above
                the highest level among their existing household members; when
                the owner has no existing household member no cap applies.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region taken from the REGION segment of the owner's
                memberId (the region derived from the owner's postcode).
                'UNKNOWN' when the memberId carries no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the owner's
                locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table
                (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the locality carries
                no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, more than 80
                owners had already been created for the same day; false
                otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, its city already
                held between 40 and 49 owners (compared case-insensitively),
                approaching the per-city capacity limit of 50; false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from whether an
                email is present. 'EMAIL' when the owner has an email, 'PHONE'
                otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as of the
                'registrationDate'. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64
                inclusive, 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate
                was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'.
                TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise
                'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region
                (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId or empty>'.
                All duplicate detection is expressed through this single key: a
                create whose whole identity key equals an existing owner's is

              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner, formatted
                '/api/owners/<id>'.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, it was not a hard
                duplicate but shared an existing owner's last name and postcode with
                a different telephone; false otherwise. Always false for a declared
                household member (one created with 'sharesHousehold' set to true),

              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate of,
                set only when 'possibleDuplicate' is true; null otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                A single roll-up risk signal. True when any of the owner's risk
                conditions holds: the owner is a possible duplicate
                ('possibleDuplicate' is true), the owner's email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (not itself on the disposable-domain
                blocklist, but a subdomain of a blocklisted domain such as

                domain's second-level label under a different top-level domain
                such as 'mailinator.net'), or the owner's city was over its soft
                capacity on create ('capacityWarning' is true). False when none
                of these holds.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                True when the owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE
                /api/owners/{id}; false for an active owner. A soft-deleted
                owner's record is retained and still readable, but it is ignored
                by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific of the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR). When
            present it is combined with the last name to form the 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on create for
            backward compatibility as a single flat line, and always returned.
            When the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are
            supplied they take precedence and this value is the composed,
            normalized address (the normalized 'addressLine1', with a single
            space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when present).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when present; an owner is valid
            when it supplies either a non-blank 'addressLine1' or the flat
            'address', plus a city. Stored and returned normalized.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address (for example an apartment or unit). When present it is
            normalized and appended to the composed 'address' after a single
            space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is converted to
            E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present,
            otherwise the country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0'
            is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must carry 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. So
            '0412 345 678' is stored and returned as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when
            omitted it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when present it is used to
            derive the owner's 'ageBand'. Provided and returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be four
            digits and, when the city belongs to a known region (Sydney->NSW,
            Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), fall within that region's postcode
            range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no
            known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as
            given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag supplied on create. An owner may join an existing
            household (another owner with the same last name and postcode); the
            joining owner's membershipLevel is capped at one above the household's
            current maximum. When true, the owner is declared a genuine household
            member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate; when absent or
            false the owner is still registered but is flagged as a possible
            duplicate of the existing household member.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formed as the title followed by a single
                space and the last name (for example 'DR who'), or just the last
                name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last
                name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes. For
                example '+61412345678' is returned as '+61 412 345 678'. The raw
                'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member identifier, formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'. REGION is the region code derived from
                the owner's postcode (UNKNOWN when it maps to no known region); FY
                is the two-digit fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate (the fiscal year starts on 1 July and is
                identified by the calendar year in which it ends); HASH8 is the
                first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the
                normalized telephone concatenated with the last name; and CHK is a
                single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. On collision with an existing owner's
                memberId a '-<n>' suffix (n starting at 2) is appended.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate,
                formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal
                year. The fiscal year runs from 1 July to 30 June and is
                identified by the calendar year in which it ends, so a
                registration on or after 1 July belongs to the fiscal year ending
                the following calendar year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners that belong to the same
                household. Derived deterministically as the first 12 hex
                characters of the SHA-256 digest of the owner's normalized last
                name, a '|' separator and the postcode, so every owner sharing a
                last name and postcode resolves to the same value automatically.
                Null when the owner was created without a postcode.
              type: string
              example: '1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Zero when the owner's name was
                unique on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned on create. Starts at 0,
                gains 2 when an email is present, gains 1 when the owner's name
                was unique on create (namesakeCount is 0), gains 2 for a
                household of three or more members, and gains 3 for tenure over
                one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned on create.
                Derived from membershipPoints: level 1 (0-1 points), level 2
                (2-3 points), level 3 (4-5 points), level 4 (6 or more points).
                A new owner's level is then capped so it never exceeds one above
                the highest level among their existing household members; when
                the owner has no existing household member no cap applies.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region taken from the REGION segment of the owner's
                memberId (the region derived from the owner's postcode).
                'UNKNOWN' when the memberId carries no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the owner's
                locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table
                (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the locality carries
                no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, more than 80
                owners had already been created for the same day; false
                otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, its city already
                held between 40 and 49 owners (compared case-insensitively),
                approaching the per-city capacity limit of 50; false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from whether an
                email is present. 'EMAIL' when the owner has an email, 'PHONE'
                otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as of the
                'registrationDate'. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64
                inclusive, 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate
                was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'.
                TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise
                'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region
                (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId or empty>'.
                All duplicate detection is expressed through this single key: a
                create whose whole identity key equals an existing owner's is
                rejected with a 409 Conflict, while any difference (a different
                telephone, email or household) is allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner, formatted
                '/api/owners/<id>'.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, it was not a hard
                duplicate but shared an existing owner's last name and postcode with
                a different telephone; false otherwise. Always false for a declared
                household member (one created with 'sharesHousehold' set to true),
                which is not treated as a suspected duplicate.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate of,
                set only when 'possibleDuplicate' is true; null otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                A single roll-up risk signal. True when any of the owner's risk
                conditions holds: the owner is a possible duplicate
                ('possibleDuplicate' is true), the owner's email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (not itself on the disposable-domain
                blocklist, but a subdomain of a blocklisted domain such as
                'inbox.mailinator.com', or a look-alike sharing a blocklisted
                domain's second-level label under a different top-level domain
                such as 'mailinator.net'), or the owner's city was over its soft
                capacity on create ('capacityWarning' is true). False when none
                of these holds.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                True when the owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE
                /api/owners/{id}; false for an active owner. A soft-deleted
                owner's record is retained and still readable, but it is ignored
                by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:

        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer

          minimum: 0

        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer

          title: Total elements

          type: integer

        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0

      required:

    PetPage:
      title: Pet page
      description: A page of pets.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pets in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of pets matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content

    PetFields:
      title: Pet fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet.

          maxLength: 30

        birthDate:

        type:

    Pet:
      title: Pet

              title: ID

    VetFields:
      title: VetFields

          title: First name

    PetTypeFields:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific of the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR). When
            present it is combined with the last name to form the 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on create for
            backward compatibility as a single flat line, and always returned.
            When the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are
            supplied they take precedence and this value is the composed,
            normalized address (the normalized 'addressLine1', with a single
            space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when present).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when present; an owner is valid
            when it supplies either a non-blank 'addressLine1' or the flat
            'address', plus a city. Stored and returned normalized.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address (for example an apartment or unit). When present it is
            normalized and appended to the composed 'address' after a single
            space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is converted to
            E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present,
            otherwise the country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0'
            is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must carry 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. So
            '0412 345 678' is stored and returned as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when
            omitted it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when present it is used to
            derive the owner's 'ageBand'. Provided and returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be four
            digits and, when the city belongs to a known region (Sydney->NSW,
            Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), fall within that region's postcode
            range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no
            known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as
            given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag supplied on create. An owner may join an existing
            household (another owner with the same last name and postcode); the
            joining owner's membershipLevel is capped at one above the household's
            current maximum. When true, the owner is declared a genuine household
            member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate; when absent or
            false the owner is still registered but is flagged as a possible
            duplicate of the existing household member.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formed as the title followed by a single
                space and the last name (for example 'DR who'), or just the last
                name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last
                name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes. For
                example '+61412345678' is returned as '+61 412 345 678'. The raw
                'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner representation. Fixed at 2 for the
                version-2 owner identity, under which the memberId, identityKey
                and householdId are grouped in the nested 'identity' object and
                rederived with a version-2 algorithm.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate,
                formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal
                year. The fiscal year runs from 1 July to 30 June and is
                identified by the calendar year in which it ends, so a
                registration on or after 1 July belongs to the fiscal year ending
                the following calendar year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners that belong to the same
                household. Derived deterministically as the first 12 hex
                characters of the SHA-256 digest of the owner's normalized last
                name, a '|' separator and the postcode, so every owner sharing a
                last name and postcode resolves to the same value automatically.
                Null when the owner was created without a postcode.
              type: string
              example: '1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Zero when the owner's name was
                unique on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned on create. Starts at 0,
                gains 2 when an email is present, gains 1 when the owner's name
                was unique on create (namesakeCount is 0), gains 2 for a
                household of three or more members, and gains 3 for tenure over
                one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned on create.
                Derived from membershipPoints: level 1 (0-1 points), level 2
                (2-3 points), level 3 (4-5 points), level 4 (6 or more points).
                A new owner's level is then capped so it never exceeds one above
                the highest level among their existing household members; when
                the owner has no existing household member no cap applies.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region taken from the REGION segment of the owner's
                memberId (the region derived from the owner's postcode).
                'UNKNOWN' when the memberId carries no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the owner's
                locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table
                (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the locality carries
                no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, more than 80
                owners had already been created for the same day; false
                otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, its city already
                held between 40 and 49 owners (compared case-insensitively),
                approaching the per-city capacity limit of 50; false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from whether an
                email is present. 'EMAIL' when the owner has an email, 'PHONE'
                otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as of the
                'registrationDate'. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64
                inclusive, 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate
                was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'.
                TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise
                'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region
                (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId or empty>'.
                All duplicate detection is expressed through this single key: a
                create whose whole identity key equals an existing owner's is
                rejected with a 409 Conflict, while any difference (a different
                telephone, email or household) is allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner, formatted
                '/api/owners/<id>'.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, it was not a hard
                duplicate but shared an existing owner's last name and postcode with
                a different telephone; false otherwise. Always false for a declared
                household member (one created with 'sharesHousehold' set to true),
                which is not treated as a suspected duplicate.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate of,
                set only when 'possibleDuplicate' is true; null otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                A single roll-up risk signal. True when any of the owner's risk
                conditions holds: the owner is a possible duplicate
                ('possibleDuplicate' is true), the owner's email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (not itself on the disposable-domain
                blocklist, but a subdomain of a blocklisted domain such as
                'inbox.mailinator.com', or a look-alike sharing a blocklisted
                domain's second-level label under a different top-level domain
                such as 'mailinator.net'), or the owner's city was over its soft
                capacity on create ('capacityWarning' is true). False when none
                of these holds.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                True when the owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE
                /api/owners/{id}; false for an active owner. A soft-deleted
                owner's record is retained and still readable, but it is ignored
                by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetPage:
      title: Pet page
      description: A page of pets.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pets in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of pets matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetFields:
      title: Pet fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet.
          type: string
          maxLength: 30
          example: Leo
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2010-09-07'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PetAgeValidation"
        type:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetType'
      required:
        - name
        - birthDate
        - type
    Pet:
      title: Pet
      description: A pet.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            ownerId:
              title: Owner ID
              description: The ID of the pet's owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            visits:
              title: Visits
              description: Vet visit bookings for this pet.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Visit'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - id
            - type
            - visits
    VetFields:
      title: VetFields
      description: Editable fields of a veterinarian.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: 'James'
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: 'Carter'
        specialties:
          title: Specialties
          description: The specialties of the vet.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Specialty'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - specialties
    Vet:
      title: Vet
      description: A veterinarian.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VetFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the vet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
      required:
        - id
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - specialties
    VisitFields:
      title: Visit fields
      description: Editable fields of a vet visit.
      type: object
      properties:
        date:
          title: Date
          description: The date of the visit.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        description:
          title: Description
          description: The description for the visit.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'rabies shot'
      required:
        - description
    Visit:
      title: Visit
      description: A booking for a vet visit.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VisitFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the visit.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            petId:
              title: Pet ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
            - petId
    PetTypeFields:
      title: PetType fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet type.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet type.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: cat
      required:
        - name
    PetType:
      title: Pet type
      description: A pet type.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetTypeFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet type.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
    User:
      title: User
      description: An user.
      type: object
      properties:
        username:
          title: username
          description: The username
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: john.doe
        password:
          title: Password
          description: The password
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: 1234abc
        enabled:
          title: enabled
          description: Indicates if the user is enabled
          type: boolean
          example: true
        roles:
          title: Roles
          description: The roles of an user
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Role'
      required:
        - username
    Role:
      title: Role
      description: A role.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: name
          description: The role's name
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: admin
      required:
        - name

openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage
      summary: Lists pet owners with pagination
      description: Returns a page of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
            example: 5
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner page found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerPage'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            Etag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: getOwner
      summary: Get a pet owner by ID
      description: Returns the pet owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
